description: This script is designed to fix prebuilt ELF check errors in Android.mk files by updating certain makefile variables such as LOCAL_SHARED_LIBRARIES, LOCAL_MULTILIB, or adding LOCAL_CHECK_ELF_FILES. It includes command-line argument parsing and utilizes the Rewriter class from elfcheck.rewriter to perform modifications.

classes.name: Rewriter
classes.description: A class responsible for performing the rewriting of Android.mk files to fix ELF check issues.

methods.name: _parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments including the Android.mk file path, inplace update option, and extra makefile variables.

methods.name: _parse_arg_var(args_var)
methods.description: Converts a list of KEY=VALUE strings into a dictionary of variables.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the Rewriter with provided arguments and performs the rewrite operation, either in-place or to standard output.
